items.title: LastStats Showcase Preview Site
items.body: Here is a preview of the new LastStats showcase website. Please note that this is an early draft, so it is still a work in progress and remains subject to minor updates and adjustments. Feel free to check it out!  https://sanobld.github.io/LastStats/

items.title: Save your API keys before updating
items.body: Before updating to v2.9.9-beta, save your Last.fm API key and secret key. After updating, resetting the app is recommended to properly reconfigure both keys.
